sql: SELECT MAX(year) as maxyr, MIN(year) as minyr FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE year=2026 AND month<=6

SELECT DISTINCT agency_name, agency_state_name, ori FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE year=2025 AND (
  agency_name ILIKE 'NEW YORK CITY%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'LOS ANGELES%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'CHICAGO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'HOUSTON%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'PHOENIX%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'PHILADELPHIA%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'SAN ANTONIO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'SAN DIEGO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'DALLAS%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'AUSTIN%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'SAN JOSE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'FORT WORTH%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'COLUMBUS%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'SAN FRANCISCO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'INDIANAPOLIS%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'SEATTLE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'DENVER%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'WASHINGTON%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'NASHVILLE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'OKLAHOMA CITY%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'BOSTON%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'EL PASO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'PORTLAND%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'MEMPHIS%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'BALTIMORE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'MILWAUKEE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'TUCSON%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'ALBUQUERQUE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'DETROIT%'
)
AND agency_name NOT ILIKE '%COUNTY%' AND agency_name NOT ILIKE '%SHERIFF%' AND agency_name NOT ILIKE '%STATE POLICE%'
ORDER BY agency_name

SELECT ori, year, SUM(actual_murder) as murders, MAX(population_1) as pop
FROM crime.cde_reta
WHERE ori IN ('TX11300','TXHPD00','CA01900','CA01942','TXSPD00','TXDPD00','TX05700','ILCPD00','OHCOP00','PAPEP00','PA05100','CODPD00','CO01600','WASPD00','TNMPD00','WIMPD00','WI04100','MDBPD00','DCMPD00','INIPD00')
AND year=2022
GROUP BY ori, year
ORDER BY ori

SELECT ori, year, SUM(actual_murder) as murders, MAX(population_1) as pop
FROM crime.cde_reta
WHERE ori IN ('AZ00723','CA03800','CA03801','CA03700','CA03711','CA04313','TX00800','TX22701','TX22012','TX07100','FL01600','NC06001','KY05680','NV00201','OR02602','AZ01003','NM00101','OK05506','MA01301','MI82349')
AND year=2022
GROUP BY ori, year
ORDER BY ori

SELECT ori, agency_name, agency_state_name FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE year=2025 AND (agency_name ILIKE 'NEW YORK CITY POLICE%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'NASHVILLE METRO%' OR agency_name ILIKE 'METROPOLITAN%NASHVILLE%' OR (agency_name ILIKE 'NASHVILLE%' AND agency_state_name ILIKE 'TENNES%'))
SELECT DISTINCT ori, agency_name, agency_state_name FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE year=2025 AND agency_state_name ILIKE 'NEW YO%' AND agency_name ILIKE '%POLICE DEPT%'
SELECT ori, agency_name FROM crime.cde_reta WHERE year=2022 AND ori LIKE 'NY%' GROUP BY ori, agency_name HAVING SUM(actual_murder) > 200

WITH cities AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('NY03030'),('CA01942'),('ILCPD00'),('TXHPD00'),('AZ00723'),('PAPEP00'),('TXSPD00'),
    ('CA03711'),('TXDPD00'),('TX22701'),('FL01600'),('CA04313'),('TX22012'),('OHCOP00'),
    ('NC06001'),('CA03801'),('INIPD00'),('WASPD00'),('CODPD00'),('DCMPD00'),('TN01901'),
    ('OK05506'),('MA01301'),('MI82349'),('TNMPD00'),('KY05680'),('MDBPD00'),('NV00201'),('WIMPD00')
  ) AS t(ori)
)
SELECT r.year, SUM(r.actual_murder) as h1_murders, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ori) as n_agencies
FROM crime.cde_reta r JOIN cities c ON r.ori = c.ori
WHERE r.year IN (2022,2025,2026) AND r.month <= 6
GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year

WITH cities AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('NY03030'),('CA01942'),('ILCPD00'),('TXHPD00'),('AZ00723'),('PAPEP00'),('TXSPD00'),
    ('CA03711'),('TXDPD00'),('TX22701'),('FL01600'),('CA04313'),('TX22012'),('OHCOP00'),
    ('NC06001'),('CA03801'),('INIPD00'),('WASPD00'),('CODPD00'),('DCMPD00'),('TN01901'),
    ('OK05506'),('MA01301'),('MI82349'),('TNMPD00'),('KY05680'),('MDBPD00'),('NV00201'),('WIMPD00')
  ) AS t(ori)
)
SELECT r.year, SUM(r.actual_murder) as full_year_murders, SUM(r.population_1) as total_pop, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ori) as n_agencies
FROM crime.cde_reta r JOIN cities c ON r.ori = c.ori
WHERE r.year IN (2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025)
GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year
